summary.headline: Judgments on Children
summary.text: Astrological judgments on children: Jupiter’s triplicity lords, Jupiter and Mercury, the part of children, angular and succedent places, planetary aspects, and freedom from evils are used to predict many or few children, their fortune, harmony, sadness, or the death of a firstborn.
